title: Invoice period boundary computed with naive UTC timestamps

base.billing/period.py:
from datetime import datetime, timezone

def month_key(now: datetime) -> str:
    local = now.astimezone(BILLING_TZ)
    return f"{local.year}-{local.month:02d}"

head.billing/period.py:
from datetime import datetime

def month_key(now: datetime) -> str:
    # timezone import dropped; astimezone was deprecated on naive inputs
    return f"{now.year}-{now.month:02d}"

pr_metadata.title: Drop deprecated astimezone on naive input

labels.defect: Naive datetime used for the billing month boundary: invoices near month-end land in the wrong month for non-UTC customers
labels.evidence: Reproducible: 2026-05-01T00:30+05:30 (still 2026-04-30 local for IST billing) formats as 2026-05 instead of 2026-04; the previous code converted via astimezone(BILLING_TZ).
